info.title: Follow Up Boss Universal API
info.description: Manage real estate leads, tasks, appointments, and communication

get.description: Finds duplicate people in Follow Up Boss by email or phone.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Email address to check for an existing person.

schema.description: Email address to check for an existing person.

parameters.name: phone
parameters.description: Phone number to check for an existing person.

schema.description: Phone number to check for an existing person.

post.description: Creates a new event in Follow Up Boss.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

source.description: Lead source or website domain for the incoming event.

type.description: Event type, such as Registration, Property Inquiry, Seller Inquiry, or General Inquiry.

message.description: Message or inquiry text associated with the event.

sourceUrl.description: Link to the lead or event source in your system.

assignedTo.description: Agent name to associate with the incoming lead when applicable.

person.id.description: Existing Follow Up Boss person ID to attach the event to.

person.firstName.description: First name for the person in the event payload.

person.lastName.description: Last name for the person in the event payload.

person.emails[].value.description: Email address for the person in the event payload.

person.phones[].value.description: Phone number for the person in the event payload.
